sentences.en: Ingenious solutions often capture our attention because of their simplicity.
sentences.zh: 天才的解决方案往往因为其简单性而吸引我们的注意。

sentences.en: An original written with simplicity and clarity makes translators happy.
sentences.zh: 一篇用朴素和清晰的语言写成的文章会让译者感到高兴。

sentences.en: The road to simplicity is paved with hellish complexities.
sentences.zh: 通往简单的道路铺满了地狱般的复杂性。

senses.zh: 简单，朴素,质朴，天真,卑贱,无知
